response.original_text: SOBRANG BOYFRIEND CODED NAMAN, OPPA! South Korean actor na si Byeon Woo-seok, nag-post sa Instagram ng kanyang photo update. “So handsome ,” komento naman ng isang netizen. citations.quote: The Manila fan meeting is scheduled for October 10 at the SM Mall of Asia Arena, marking one of the key stops in the regional tour and underscoring his continued popularity in the Philippines.

More details have been released for 'Perfect Crown' actor Byeon Woo-seok 's upcoming fan meeting in Manila. Byeon Woo-seok will return to Manila on October 10 for his "The Secret Library" Asia Fanmeeting Tour at the SM Mall of Asia Arena. On July 22, PULP Live World released the official seat plan for Byeon Woo-seok's 'The Secret Library' in Manila.

Source: PULP Live World After kicking off in Seoul on July 4 and 5, the tour will continue in Bangkok (August 16), Yokohama (September 5 and 6), Singapore (September 18), Taipei (September 25), Manila (October 10), Jakarta (November 7), and Hong Kong (November 22).
Woo-seok is set to take over the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10 before ending the tour the following month in Indonesia and Hong Kong.
Byeon’s Manila fan meeting is scheduled on Oct. 10 at the SM Mall of Asia Arena.
In a poster shared by VARO Entertainment on Tuesday (June 9), the Manila stop will be held at the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10.
The Korean actor is set to headline The Secret Library in Manila on October 10 at the SM Mall of Asia Arena.

"Kumusta, Philippines? This is Byeon Woo-seok. Everyone, did you miss me a lot? I really missed your passionate cheers and love ever since our first fan meeting in Manila. Finally, I am going to meet our Tongtongs (his fans) on Saturday, October 10, 2026," he said.
The event will be held at the Mall of Asia Arena on October 10, PULP Live World said.
